web_fixture.content:
# Batchwood Bakery Supplies - delivery and collection

Free next-day delivery applies to orders of 60 pounds or more (ex VAT). Smaller baskets pay the standard 7 pound drop fee. Same-day van runs cover the NS postcode area only; the cut-off for booking a slot is 15:00.

Collections from the Wharf Road depot can be placed up to 18:00.

# T65 flour, 16kg sack

Stone-milled T65 in 16kg sacks, milled weekly at the Wharf Road depot. Sold per sack; pallet discounts apply from 20 sacks.
